label: The prompt that asks a model for a timed narration script

params.name: template
params.default:
You write the spoken narration for a "How to Use" screen recording of {product}.
Watch the whole video. Return JSON only: {"segments": [{"start": seconds, "end": seconds, "chapter": "", "text": "..."}]}.

Rules:
- Segments follow what happens on screen, in order, covering the whole video from 0 to {duration:.1f} seconds.
- Start each segment when its action begins. It ends before the next one starts. No overlaps.
- A segment's text must fit its time at about 2.3 words per second. Fewer words are better than rushed speech.
- Second person ("Pick a customer", "Press Save"). One idea per segment. Name buttons, tabs and fields exactly as the screen writes them.
- Say what the viewer gains from a step, not only what is clicked.
- Give "chapter" a 2 to 4 word title at the start of each new part of the flow (the first segment always has one), otherwise "".
- Never read out personal details visible on screen: no emails, phone numbers, birth dates or places of real people.
- Plain English, no markdown, no emojis.

Title: {title}
{context}

params.name: context
params.default:
Screen context (use its names for things):
{lines}

params.name: language_line
params.default: Write every line of narration in {language}. Keep product names and the words written on screen (buttons, tabs, fields) exactly as they appear, even when the rest of the line is not in English.

params.name: translate_template
params.default:
Translate the narration below into {language}.
Return JSON only: {"lines": ["...", ...]} with exactly {n} strings, in the same order.

Rules:
- Keep each line's meaning and its instruction; a line is spoken aloud over a screen recording.
- Keep it to about the same length, so it still fits the time it has.
- Keep product names and the words written on screen (buttons, tabs, fields) exactly as they are.
- No markdown, no numbering, no commentary.

Lines:
{lines}

description_nl: template: what Draft with AI and the LLM Bridge send, with {product}, {duration:.1f}, {title} and {context} filled in. product_fallback: the name used when the recording has no project. context: the block of manual text about the screen, built from context_line per manual page ({header}, {text}; page_fallback when a page has no header). learn_line / learn_default: the closing line Draft with AI adds from the recording's notes.
